name: Todo List
description: Keep a private list of personal tasks with priorities and due dates
backend_requirements: Access control: require auth for every todo endpoint; each signed-in user sees and changes only their own todos; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Todo validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 255 characters; description, when given, is at most 2000 characters; priority is one of low, medium, high (default medium); due_date, when given, is a date (YYYY-MM-DD); completed defaults to false

GET /api/todos returns the user's active todos, open ones first, then by due_date (todos without one last), then newest first; ?completed=true or false and ?priority= filter the list, ?page= and ?page_size= page it (page_size default 50, at most 200), total counts every matching todo and remaining counts the user's open todos regardless of filters

PATCH /api/todos/:id changes only the fields it is given (title, description, priority, due_date, completed); sending due_date null clears it; completed_at is set when a todo becomes completed and cleared when it is reopened
Deactivated todos (is_active false) are left out of the owner's list and answer 404 on the todo endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Visitors see a short description of the app and a 'Sign in to keep your todo list' prompt; the list and every control are for signed-in users
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Todo list: each todo shows its title, priority, due date (overdue open todos are highlighted) and a completed checkbox that saves immediately; a counter shows how many todos remain open
Filter tabs for All, Active and Completed, a priority filter, and a 'Load more' button when more todos exist
An add form (title, optional description, priority, optional due date) and inline editing of a todo, both showing the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every user's todos, active or not, with the owner's username and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a todo's active status from the overview

data_models.description: One task on a user's private list

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who owns it)
fields.title: string (required, max 255 chars)
fields.priority: string (one of: low, medium, high; default medium)
fields.completed_at: datetime (optional; set when completed, cleared when reopened; ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the todo from its owner)
